messages.subject: Protected conversation 11 Dec — file note
messages.plaintextBody:
Miriam, Nathan,

My note of yesterday's protected conversation is attached. Key points: Daniel is reserving on constructive dismissal and protected-disclosure detriment (the Brampton Leisure revenue-recognition point from July); he reacted badly to the £150k ex gratia as an opener. Next step is our without-prejudice letter recording the offer, going out Monday with a first draft agreement.

Please flag any corrections to the note.

Tom

--
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
tom.gallagher@whitfieldcarter.com
